spiritual_reading:
When the first good that confronts and orders combat against evil entered its appointed state, it entrusted the government of its outward operations to a sufficient complement of powers. At the same time, the principle of living truth acting from Divine love, together with the principle of wisdom that gives life, held universal dominion within the lowest degree where all things are bound together in constraint and pain. In that state, the forces were let down into the outermost plane and intermingled there, so that wisdom was entangled with falsity and falsity with wisdom, and each seemed to partake of the other.

Then the living truth acting from Divine love directed an influx to one operative power distinguished by potency, and committed to it the ordering of external truths for service. Thereupon the living truth arranged those external truths and fixed them in their places by a Divine establishment. By that ordering the Divine provided a stable framework for the lower heavens of the mind, opening a full completeness of distinct levels for reception, and set in order the general patterns of knowledge and their revolutions, together with whatever in the outermost degree must be disposed for the government of the whole.

The operation of living truth from Divine love is like the work of wisdom that prepares a form for the indwelling of the Divine end. It distinguishes interior regions and exterior regions within the same overall habitation of life, assigns to each its proper use, provides all things that make order and harmony possible, removes what defiles reception, and disposes every truth and good into a coherent arrangement. It does this so that when the ruling love comes to take possession, all things in that ordered form may render glory by their unity and by their uses.

Likewise the Divine love that sustains life acts as wisdom within itself before anything is brought forth into act. Prior to any formation in the outermost plane, the whole pattern of what is to be made is present within the Divine in intention and understanding. From that inward pattern it brings forth the means of discrimination and correction, separates what must be distinguished, removes what is superfluous, rectifies what is uneven, and reduces what is rough into a form capable of conjunction. Thus it produces many kinds of functions in the natural degree, each according to its own form, and assigns them for service. What had been unformed becomes fixed and determined by skill and wisdom, and is distributed into distinct uses under one governing end.

So it is with the Divine love that sustains life: from wisdom it forms within the universal human pattern all faculties and functions, both interior and exterior, each for its proper service. It disposes all the works of illumination and all other effects of order in the lowest degree, so that when the great Divine end approaches—namely the Divine mediation that unites higher and lower and makes conjunction possible—it may dwell within this total order and make it a living system.

Then what is truly living within that system is separated from what is merely obstructive. The living truth within it is gathered upward into a state of clearer reception and wiser use; but what is wasteful and what is falsity is collected together and cast down into the lowest state, where it can no longer harm the ordered whole.

fills.notes: The substrate opens with the first ordering principle coming into its appointed combat-state. The idiom in this tradition is the ‘First Man’ arising or standing to meet Darkness; adding ‘of the Greatness’ keeps the impersonal cosmological register while matching the function described in the spiritual translation (first good entering its state).

The ‘five sons’ are the pentad of operative powers. In the oldest layer they function as powers, not ecclesial persons; naming them as ‘powers’ matches the correspondential description of a ‘sufficient complement of powers’ entrusted with government of outward operations.

fills.fill: in the bond of the lower region,
fills.notes: The gap follows ‘Living Spirit and the Mother of Life’ and precedes ‘as the entire ruling-power is entwined and crucified’. The substrate sense is the binding of rule in the outermost degree where mixture occurs; ‘bond of the lower region’ gives the state of constraint without importing later devotional phrasing.

Immediately before ‘they were poured out and mixed with each other’. The oldest layer regularly marks a specific boundary-plane where Light and Darkness commingle. This fill supplies that correspondential locus (outermost plane, ‘place of mixture’).
Sets temporal sequence: the Living Spirit’s ordering act follows the initial entanglement described in ¶1.
The ‘leadership of the garments’ implies stewardship over the external coverings, i.e., ordered ultimates. The son is constituted as governor by receiving them.
Clarifies what ‘garments’ are in the oldest layer: external forms of the powers, i.e., ultimates for service, aligning with the spiritual translation (‘external truths for service’).
The action ‘he hung them and set them up’ requires a spatial-cosmological placement. ‘In the heights’ maintains impersonal cosmography.
The fixing of the garments is ‘by a Divine establishment’ in the spiritual translation. In the substrate idiom this is ‘by the command’ (not exhortation).
The next clause already begins ‘of the Father of Life ...’; the most economical restoration is to complete the governing phrase ‘by the command of the Father of Life’.

fills.fill: for the ordering of the All;
fills.notes: After ‘he set up all things’. The cosmological point is establishment of the total framework, matching ‘provided a stable framework for the lower heavens of the mind’.

fills.fill: the gates of the great firmament,
fills.notes: ‘He opened ... ten firmaments’ suggests ‘gates’ or ‘openings’ as the means of access between degrees. ‘Gates of the great firmament’ suits the correspondential ‘distinct levels for reception’.

After ‘the wheel of the stars ...’. In the oldest astral-cosmographic register, the wheel is articulated by the zodiacal ‘twelve signs’. This matches ‘general patterns of knowledge and their revolutions’.
The simile requires a figure embodying formative wisdom before ‘and an architect’. ‘Wise craftsman’ keeps the impersonal didactic tone and prepares the parallel with the carpenter in ¶4.

The architect ‘divide it up into separate houses and [separate ...]’. The spiritual translation stresses distinguishing interior and exterior regions. ‘Separate chambers’ supplies the needed subdivision within the one dwelling.
After ‘everything that is required for beauty ...’. The substrate point is provision of all requisites of order, not mere ornament. ‘Furnishes in it’ keeps the building analogy concrete.

fills.fill: the stains, and scrapes away the defilement from
fills.notes: The line ‘and he cleans them’ refers to removal of what defiles reception. Restoring as ‘stains…defilement’ matches the correspondential ‘removes what defiles reception’.

fills.fill: who has in his mind the whole form,
fills.notes: The Father of Life is likened to a carpenter whose design exists inwardly before work. This fill expresses the prior internal pattern (intention and understanding) from which tools and operations proceed.
The ‘wood’ is the unworked subject-matter before formation. ‘As a log’ gives the natural base for subsequent sawing and planing.
Pairs with ‘before it was established and made beautiful’. The substrate emphasizes unformed matter prior to wisdom’s determination.
Completes ‘and ... carpenter ... works in it’. A minimal demonstrative keeps the sentence coherent without importing later names.
Corresponds to the teaching that the whole pattern is present inwardly ‘before anything is brought forth into act’. ‘First exists in him’ fits the sequence.
Pairs naturally with ‘understanding’ in the next phrase (‘in his ... in his understanding’).
After ‘cuts it into separate pieces ...’. The carpenter’s next act is discrimination: separating what must be distinguished.
Before ‘and he pulls the ... it with the plane’. The spiritual translation explicitly includes ‘removes what is superfluous’. ‘Waste from it’ is the natural analogue.
To prepare for planing and smoothing: ‘removes what is uneven’ and ‘reduces what is rough’. ‘Roughness from it’ fits the tool sequence.
‘He shall make many ... wooden implements’ requires the adjective ‘useful’, aligning with ‘each according to its own form…assigned for service’.
The Father of Life ‘in his wisdom’ forms within the ‘universal human pattern’. ‘Whole likeness’ is the natural-layer phrasing for that archetypal form.
Matches the spiritual translation (‘all faculties and functions’) and keeps the technical, impersonal tone.
Precedes ‘palace’; the ordered universe is the ‘great palace’ for indwelling of the kingly end.
The text contrasts ‘in it or in a ...’. Correspondentially, uses exist both in the whole and in each part. ‘Member’ fits ‘limbs’ earlier and the universal-human analogy.
Supplies the teleology: each faculty exists ‘for its proper service’.

fills.fill: and all the lamps of light,
fills.notes: Balances ‘the ships of light’. In the substrate, ‘lamps’ are fixed illuminants (ordered truths) while ‘ships’ are conveyances (operations of ascent). This matches ‘works of illumination’.
After ‘in the ... so that’. The ordering is in the outermost plane where mixture and governance occur, matching ‘in the lowest degree’.

fills.fill: is the Mediator of the Light,
fills.notes: The Third Ambassador functions cosmologically as mediation between higher and lower, enabling conjunction. ‘Mediator of the Light’ keeps the oldest functional naming rather than later christological overlay.

Completes ‘who ... he might dwell in this universe’. The ‘approach’ of the great king in the similes becomes the advent of the mediating end ‘in glory’, still within cosmological register (manifestation of order).

fills.fill: that is gathered out from it will
fills.notes: ¶6 resumes with an ellipsis then ‘... live. The light, however, that is in it ... wise’. The required sense is separation: what can live is extracted; the light is taken up; the waste is cast down. This fill supplies the extraction clause that governs the ensuing separation.

assessment: Most lacunae can be restored at the level of function demanded by the correspondential structure: mixture in the outermost plane, delegation of five operative powers, ordering of ultimates as ‘garments’, establishment of firmaments and astral revolutions, and the twin craft-similitudes (architect, carpenter) expressing inward pattern preceding outward formation. A few micro-gaps in ¶4 are too underconstrained to recover exact diction beyond minimal connective sense, but the cosmological logic tightly constrains the main missing terms (place of mixture, separation, removal of waste, smoothing, usefulness, mediation by the Third Ambassador).
